_comment: Store-specific vocabulary for the agnostic core. MECHANISMS live in services/ (product_claim_guard.py, product_classifier.py); this FLAVOUR (brands/specs/types/price-bands) is per-store config. Swap this file per ecommerce vertical. Defaults below are the laptop/computer demo.
_product_types_comment: Ordered classification rules — FIRST match wins. Accessory/specific types are listed BEFORE 'laptop' on purpose so 'Laptop Brief' classifies as a bag, not a laptop. 'primary' types are what this store sells as its headline product; everything else is an accessory that is excluded from primary results but eligible for cart upsell.

product_type_rules.pattern: \b(ssd|hdd|hard drive|flash drive|usb drive|sd card|micro ?sd|memory card|portable ssd|external drive|nvme drive)\b
\b(mouse|keyboard|webcam|docking station|dock\b|usb hub|hub\b|laptop stand|stand\b|cooling pad|charger|power adapter|adapter|hdmi|ethernet cable|cable|card reader)\b

_price_bands_comment: Expected price band (whole currency units) per type — a data-integrity / poisoning guard. A price OUTSIDE its type band is a price_anomaly: too-low can be a poisoning attack (sell a $1800 laptop for $45 → direct margin loss at checkout); too-high can be denial-of-inventory or reputational. Bands are generous (5th–95th percentile-ish), not pricing rules.
_upsell_comment: Companion types to cross-sell in the cart once a primary item is added (laptop → carry it, protect it, expand it, hear it). Powers services/upsell_engine.py type-affinity.
